conditions.condition_text: Identify a Supply Zone where aggressive sellers overwhelmed buyers, driving price down.
This imbalance indicates institutional footprint and potential reversal.
Mark the Supply Zone from the open to the high of the base candle.

Wait for aggressive sellers to step in (weakening buyers) upon retesting the zone.
Confirmation of institutional interest upon zone retest is the entry trigger.
Refine the entry on a lower timeframe (e.g., 5m) using support/resistance, trendline breaks, or other confirmation.
Lower timeframes provide precise entry triggers for the larger zone.
The zone is formed where aggressive sellers overwhelmed buyers, driving price down.
Supply zones are located above the current price.
Sellers stepping in upon retest of the zone confirms a solid entry point.
The stop is placed above the entry level to protect against a false breakout.
Target the next level of liquidity below the entry.
